subject: Combine coastal and riverine flood at a site into one hazard curve

checks.name: INT-DOMAIN
checks.title: expected loss integrates the full probability domain
checks.detail: fixture and 13 live curves match the reference integral

checks.name: INT-STEP
checks.title: a flood defence is a discontinuity, not a ramp
checks.detail: every defended curve within 2% of its knotted reference

checks.name: INT-CONVERGE-PF
checks.title: portfolio loss is converged on the modelled grid
checks.detail: portfolio EAL moves -0.00% under 32x refinement

checks.name: INT-CONVERGE-PERIL
checks.title: every peril curve is converged on the modelled grid
checks.detail: no peril moves more than 5% under 32x refinement

checks.name: INT-DECOMP
checks.title: the loss decomposition reconciles
checks.detail: eal == body + tail on every curve; tail_share 1.4%

checks.name: INT-MONO-RP
checks.title: loss is non-decreasing in return period
checks.detail: rarer events are never cheaper, on every curve

checks.name: INT-SCALE
checks.title: loss is exactly linear in asset value
checks.detail: unit and portfolio both scale exactly 2x

checks.name: INT-BOUNDS
checks.title: losses stay inside their physical bounds
checks.detail: all damage fractions in [0,1]; all EALs inside asset value

checks.name: INT-MONO-INTENSITY
checks.title: a worse hazard is never a smaller loss
checks.detail: monotone in intensity on the fixture and every live curve

checks.name: INT-MONO-PROTECTION
checks.title: a taller defence is never a larger loss
checks.detail: EAL falls monotonically across protection standards: 37,500,000, 10,000,000, 2,000,000, 500,000, 100,000

checks.name: INT-DRY
checks.title: a dry asset costs exactly zero
checks.detail: exact zero on the fixture and on 2 unexposed assets

checks.name: VUL-OVERLAP
checks.title: an asset cannot be destroyed twice
checks.detail: combined damage fraction peaks at 0.773

checks.name: VUL-MDF
checks.title: the outage driver is an annual expectation, not a peak
checks.detail: mean damage fraction equals EAL / value on every curve

checks.name: VUL-BI
checks.title: a loss-making asset has non-zero business interruption
checks.detail: every exposed revenue-earning asset has positive outage cost

checks.name: VUL-EXTRAP
checks.title: damage never exceeds the curve it came from
checks.detail: damage is held flat above the last knot, never extrapolated

checks.name: INS-PAYS
checks.title: a programme with recoverable events pays out
checks.detail: every asset with recoverable events receives a recovery

checks.name: INS-BOUNDED
checks.title: recovery cannot exceed the loss or the cover
checks.detail: recovery bounded by both the loss and the programme limit

checks.name: INS-MONO-DED
checks.title: a higher deductible never recovers more
checks.detail: recovery falls monotonically as the deductible rises

checks.name: INS-RECONCILE
checks.title: the insurance headline reconciles
checks.detail: insured 55.6%, retained 44.4%, gap reconciles

checks.name: DET-REPEAT
checks.title: the same inputs give the same answer
checks.detail: byte-identical across two runs

checks.name: DET-ORDER
checks.title: asset order cannot change the answer
checks.detail: headline and rows identical under reversal

checks.name: DET-RUNID
checks.title: the run id is a function of its inputs
checks.detail: changing an asset's value from 420,000,000 to 1 left the run id at run_f7bc5cde173a. A provenance id that does not move when the portfolio moves is not a provenance id

checks.name: DET-SCENARIO
checks.title: a hotter scenario is never cheaper
checks.detail: ssp585 >= ssp245 >= ssp126 on every asset and at portfolio level

checks.name: AGG-SUM
checks.title: the whole equals the sum of its parts
checks.detail: rows, peril shares and bands all reconcile

checks.name: AGG-IN-SWEEP
checks.title: the headline is a member of its own sweep
checks.detail: headline matches a sweep point exactly and sits inside the range

checks.name: SWEEP-DISTINCT
checks.title: every sweep point is a distinct model
checks.detail: 54 sweep points carry only 30 distinct values: duplicated model configurations are biasing the median and inflating n

checks.name: SWEEP-NONDEGEN
checks.title: real disagreement survives the sweep
checks.detail: n=54, high/low 3.79

checks.name: BAND-CONSISTENT
checks.title: risk bands match the numbers they label
checks.detail: 3 bands occupied, every row correctly labelled

checks.name: COV-ATTRIBUTABLE
checks.title: a reported breach is caused by climate
checks.detail: 1 of 4 reported breaches already breach at zero climate loss: hcmc-tower (dscr_before 0.73, ltv_before 0.70)

checks.name: FIN-ZERO
checks.title: no hazard means no financial effect
checks.detail: zero hazard produces zero cost, zero impairment and no LTV movement

checks.name: PLAUS-PORTFOLIO
checks.title: portfolio loss is physically plausible
checks.detail: portfolio EAL 2.6774% of value

checks.name: PLAUS-MEDIAN
checks.title: the median asset is not a write-off
checks.detail: median asset loses 0.2506% a year

checks.name: PLAUS-CONCENTRATION
checks.title: losses are not universal
checks.detail: 1 of 12 assets above 5% of value

checks.name: PLAUS-COVERAGE
checks.title: the model is still modelling something
checks.detail: 8 assets with loss across 4 perils

checks.name: API-SHAPE
checks.title: the public surface is unchanged
checks.detail: five entry points and the Assumptions field set unchanged
